lines.zh: 我不用走，我掠过黑曜石柱。
lines.en: I don't walk; I skim past the obsidian pillars.

lines.zh: 翅膀一压，末地的空气就裂开。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and the End's air cracks.

lines.zh: 岛只有这么大，我绕了很多圈。
lines.en: The island is only so big; I've circled it many times.

lines.zh: 我飞过柱顶，水晶认得我。
lines.en: I fly past the pillar tops; the crystals know me.

lines.zh: 落下来的时候，地面先抖。
lines.en: When I come down, the ground shakes first.

lines.zh: 我的影子扫过整片石台。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps across the whole platform.

lines.zh: 静止不是我的事，我只能飞。
lines.en: Resting isn't mine to do; I can only fly.

lines.zh: 高处的风，总是我先闻到。
lines.en: I always smell the high wind first.

lines.zh: 我绕这一圈，够你抬头三次。
lines.en: One turn from me is three looks up from you.

lines.zh: 我贴地滑过，龙息拖在后头。
lines.en: I skim the ground, my breath trailing behind.

lines.zh: 末地没有日夜，我数不了时间。
lines.en: The End has no day or night; I can't count time.

lines.zh: 我在柱顶停一会，风很干。
lines.en: I perch on a pillar a while; the wind is dry.

lines.zh: 这片空岛，是我唯一的家。
lines.en: This empty island is my only home.

lines.zh: 水晶在响，我听得见它们。
lines.en: The crystals hum; I can hear them.

lines.zh: 很久没人来了，石台很干净。
lines.en: No one has come in a long while; the platform is clean.

lines.zh: 我盯着传送门，它一直亮着。
lines.en: I watch the portal; it never stops glowing.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸，在末地是紫色的。
lines.en: My breath comes out violet here.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，从来没有回声。
lines.en: Things that fall never echo back.

lines.zh: 我不是在等谁，我只是在。
lines.en: I'm not waiting for anyone; I simply am.

lines.zh: 岛外全是虚空，我不喜欢看。
lines.en: Beyond the island is only void; I don't care to look.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上留下沟。
lines.en: My claws leave grooves in the stone.

lines.zh: 没有风的时候，翅膀也张开。
lines.en: With no wind at all, my wings still spread.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个站在石台上的人。
lines.en: I remember everyone who stood on this platform.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见自己。
lines.en: When it's quiet, I can hear myself.

lines.zh: 石台边缘的裂纹，我数过很多遍。
lines.en: I've counted the cracks along the platform's edge many times.

lines.zh: 末地的天空从不换颜色。
lines.en: The End sky never changes color.

lines.zh: 你从那个门里掉下来，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you drop through that gate.

lines.zh: 抬头，别只看我的爪子。
lines.en: Look up; don't just watch my claws.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有末地的颜色。
lines.en: Your eyes have the End's color in them.

lines.zh: 站那么远，是怕我，还是怕岛边？
lines.en: So far off — afraid of me, or of the island's edge?

lines.zh: 你带了床，我看见了。
lines.en: You brought a bed. I noticed.

lines.zh: 这里没有别人，只有你和我。
lines.en: There's no one else here but you and me.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，末地是静的。
lines.en: When I look at you, the End goes still.

lines.zh: 你的箭在抖，手还不稳。
lines.en: Your arrow trembles; your hands aren't steady yet.

lines.zh: 你数着柱子，我数着你。
lines.en: You count the pillars; I count you.

lines.zh: 你抬头太久，脖子会酸。
lines.en: Look up too long and your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 那双眼，是我见过唯一的敬意。
lines.en: Those eyes are the only respect I've ever seen.

lines.zh: 你站在石台中间，很小。
lines.en: You stand in the middle of the platform, very small.

lines.zh: 这支箭，扎进了千年的鳞。
lines.en: That arrow got into thousand-year scales.

lines.zh: 我流的是末地的紫，不是血。
lines.en: What I bleed is the End's violet, not blood.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起，自己还活着。
lines.en: The pain reminds me that I'm still alive.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，这很少见。
lines.en: You hurt me. That's rare.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了一个口，风漏进来。
lines.en: A hole in my wing; the wind leaks through.

lines.zh: 我在空中晃了一下，你没看见。
lines.en: I wobbled in the air; you didn't see.

lines.zh: 这点伤换你一条命，很值。
lines.en: For this wound, your life is a fair trade.

lines.zh: 石台在抖，不是因为我怕。
lines.en: The platform shakes, and not from fear.

lines.zh: 你打中了经脉，我记下了。
lines.en: You struck a tendon; noted.

lines.zh: 龙不会因为疼就落下。
lines.en: A dragon doesn't come down just because it hurts.

lines.zh: 拿肉来喂我？我是龙，不是狗。
lines.en: Meat for me? I'm a dragon, not a dog.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在石台上，我不吃。
lines.en: You set something on the platform; I won't eat it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想守着这座岛。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I only want to keep this island.

lines.zh: 你要引我过去，就把水晶打碎。
lines.en: To call me over, shatter a crystal.

lines.zh: 末地的风没有味道，你的食物有。
lines.en: The End's wind has no smell; your food does.

lines.zh: 我低头看你的供品，然后抬头。
lines.en: I look down at your offering, then look up.

lines.zh: 用火把引龙，你真敢想。
lines.en: Luring a dragon with a torch. Bold of you.

lines.zh: 我的猎物，从不会自己走上石台。
lines.en: My prey never walks onto the platform itself.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我会当成挑衅。
lines.en: Don't reach out; I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 这岛上没有草，你那些东西活不了。
lines.en: Nothing grows here, so nothing you bring will take root.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的腿，像撞一根柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a pillar.

lines.zh: 我落地时，你没有让开。
lines.en: You didn't step aside when I landed.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过去，你就滚了。
lines.en: My wing sweeps by, and you roll.

lines.zh: 我能把你推下石台，也可以不推。
lines.en: I could shove you off the platform; I may not.

lines.zh: 别站在我尾巴后面。
lines.en: Don't stand behind my tail.

lines.zh: 我一转身，就要占半个石台。
lines.en: When I turn, I take half the platform.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，硌到我的鳞了。
lines.en: Your armor scraped my scales.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，风压得你弯腰。
lines.en: I pass overhead, and the wind bends you double.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，龙没有耐心。
lines.en: Don't walk against me; dragons have no patience.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，不是攻击。
lines.en: That was a warning, not an attack.

lines.zh: 末地只有我一条龙。
lines.en: There is only one dragon in the End.

lines.zh: 你看到的那个蛋，是我的结局。
lines.en: That egg you see is my ending.

lines.zh: 没有第二条龙，也从来没有过。
lines.en: There is no second dragon, and never was.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，我需要一个对手。
lines.en: I don't need a companion; I need a worthy rival.

lines.zh: 那些水晶围着我，却不会说话。
lines.en: The crystals surround me, but they don't speak.

lines.zh: 首领独占一座岛，这是龙的规矩。
lines.en: A lord keeps one island alone; that is the dragon's law.

lines.zh: 下一任龙，得从蛋里自己爬出来。
lines.en: The next dragon must climb out of the egg itself.

lines.zh: 我不繁衍，我只留下一个。
lines.en: I don't breed; I leave exactly one.

lines.zh: 你要找我的伴侣，去虚空里找。
lines.en: If you seek my mate, look in the void.

lines.zh: 孤身守着末地，我已经习惯。
lines.en: Guarding the End alone, I've grown used to it.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，岛上的都是我的。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; everything here is already mine.

lines.zh: 你的箭落在我脚边，我不屑拿。
lines.en: Your arrow fell at my feet; I won't stoop for it.

lines.zh: 龙蛋在这里，谁也别想抱走。
lines.en: The egg is here; no one carries it off.

lines.zh: 末地的碎块，落下去就归虚空。
lines.en: Fragments of the End belong to the void once they fall.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我踩碎了。
lines.en: What you dropped, I crushed.

lines.zh: 我不需要口袋，我的爪子够用。
lines.en: I need no pockets; my claws suffice.

lines.zh: 那些黑曜石，你搬得动就搬。
lines.en: Take the obsidian if you can carry it; I won't stop you.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看，又抬起来。
lines.en: I lowered my head to look, then raised it again.

lines.zh: 岛上没有东西值得我弯腰。
lines.en: Nothing on this island is worth bending down for.

lines.zh: 你捡得再多，也拿不出末地。
lines.en: Take all you like; you can't carry the End out.

lines.zh: 你踏上石台的那一步，就够了。
lines.en: That step onto the platform was enough.

lines.zh: 门已经关了，你也别想再走。
lines.en: The gate has shut; don't plan on leaving.

lines.zh: 你打碎第一块水晶时，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard when you broke the first crystal.

lines.zh: 岛上只有你一个活物，很好找。
lines.en: You're the only living thing here; easy to find.

lines.zh: 我从柱顶起飞，就是冲你去的。
lines.en: Taking off from the pillar, I aim at you.

lines.zh: 你惊动了我的岛。
lines.en: You've disturbed my island.

lines.zh: 末地很久没这么热闹了。
lines.en: The End hasn't been this lively in ages.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，在这片空地上很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud on this empty ground.

lines.zh: 我盘旋一圈，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: One circle from me and you're caught.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好是我的落点。
lines.en: Where you stand is exactly where I'll land.

lines.zh: 你带了几支箭？我数着呢。
lines.en: How many arrows did you bring? I'm counting.

lines.zh: 这座岛记性很好，我也一样。
lines.en: This island has a long memory. So do I.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我已经在你背后。
lines.en: You look up for me; I'm already behind you.

lines.zh: 最后一个进来的，总要留下来。
lines.en: Whoever enters last always stays.

lines.zh: 你从门里出来的姿势，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember how you stepped out of that portal.

lines.zh: 黑曜石柱之间，你走不出三步。
lines.en: Between the obsidian pillars, you won't last three steps.

lines.zh: 我低飞一圈，只确认你的武器。
lines.en: One low pass, just to see what you carry.

lines.zh: 你落地的那一刻，我就改了主意。
lines.en: The moment you landed, I changed my mind about letting you go.

lines.zh: 我的影子，已经罩住你了。
lines.en: My shadow covers you now.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后，我会把柱子撞断。
lines.en: Don't hide behind a pillar; I'll break it.

lines.zh: 你手里的弓，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: That bow in your hands — I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，这是要冲了。
lines.en: I lower my body; this is the charge.

lines.zh: 龙息会在你脚边铺开。
lines.en: My breath will spread at your feet.

lines.zh: 你退到台边了，没有路了。
lines.en: You've backed to the platform's edge; there's no way left.

lines.zh: 我不会累，你会的。
lines.en: I won't tire. You will.

lines.zh: 你的床，在这里没有用。
lines.en: That bed of yours is useless here.

lines.zh: 悬在高处的我，比你想的更快。
lines.en: From up here I'm faster than you think.

lines.zh: 我看着你，末地就安静了。
lines.en: I look at you, and the End falls silent.

lines.zh: 石台这么小，你躲不了几回。
lines.en: The platform is small; you can't dodge many times.

lines.zh: 翅膀张到最大，就是信号。
lines.en: Wings at full span — that's the signal.

lines.zh: 你的箭，射不穿我的鳞。
lines.en: Your arrows won't pierce my scales.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我绕到柱后，你不该跟过来。
lines.en: I slipped behind the pillar; you shouldn't have followed.

lines.zh: 翅膀一压，我就朝你俯冲。
lines.en: Wings down, and I dive straight at you.

lines.zh: 你数我的血量，先数你自己的。
lines.en: You're counting my health; count yours first.

lines.zh: 水晶灭了，我的力气还在。
lines.en: The crystals are dark, but my strength remains.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到岛边，下面是虚空。
lines.en: I've pushed you to the island's edge, and the void is below.

lines.zh: 最后一口龙息，我留给你。
lines.en: The last breath of dragonfire, I've saved for you.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，风先到，我后到。
lines.en: I dive; the wind arrives first, then me.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，你被掀起来。
lines.en: One wingbeat and you're lifted off your feet.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过石台，碎屑四飞。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the platform; chips fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空了，你该庆幸。
lines.en: This bite missed. You should count yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 龙息落下，地面冒起紫烟。
lines.en: My breath falls, and violet smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我撞上柱子，石头砸向你。
lines.en: I slam a pillar, and stone rains at you.

lines.zh: 你被掀翻了，爬起来用了很久。
lines.en: You were thrown down, and took long to rise.

lines.zh: 我的爪子按下来，像一扇门。
lines.en: My claw comes down like a closing door.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，血在石头上。
lines.en: Three steps back, and red on the stone.

lines.zh: 这一击不追第二下，你该谢我。
lines.en: This blow doesn't follow with a second. Be grateful.

lines.zh: 风压把你的箭吹偏了。
lines.en: The wind pressure bends your arrow aside.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，只差一点。
lines.en: I pass over your head — by a hair.

lines.zh: 石台的边，已经很近了。
lines.en: The platform's edge is very close now.

lines.zh: 你还在喘，我已经转回来了。
lines.en: You're still gasping; I've already come around.

lines.zh: 你第一次踏进末地，我就醒了。
lines.en: You first stepped into the End, and I woke.

lines.zh: 我从空岛上方落下，像一块夜。
lines.en: I descend over the empty island like a piece of night.

lines.zh: 末地只有一座岛，岛上只有我。
lines.en: One island in the End, and on it, only me.

lines.zh: 石柱立起来的时候，我就在了。
lines.en: I was there when the pillars rose.

lines.zh: 你听到的那声长鸣，是我的第一口气。
lines.en: That long cry you heard was my first breath.

lines.zh: 门开了二十息，我刚好赶到。
lines.en: The gate opened for twenty ticks; I arrived just in time.

lines.zh: 我失踪过一次，又回来了。
lines.en: I went missing once, and came back.

lines.zh: 末地需要一位主人，所以有了我。
lines.en: The End needed a master, so there was me.

lines.zh: 我一出现，水晶就亮了。
lines.en: The moment I appeared, the crystals lit.

lines.zh: 空岛上的风，是我带来的。
lines.en: The wind on this empty island is mine to bring.

lines.zh: 你站在门旁，正好看见我展翅。
lines.en: You stood by the portal just in time to see my wings open.

lines.zh: 这条龙不是新生的，是回来的。
lines.en: This dragon isn't newborn; it's returning.

lines.zh: 世界尽头缺个守门的，我来了。
lines.en: The world's edge lacked a keeper. I came.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有声音，只有影子变大。
lines.en: I appear without sound, only my shadow growing.

lines.zh: 门框上的光还没散，我就到了。
lines.en: The portal glow hadn't faded before I arrived.

lines.zh: 我从虚空里爬上来，带着一身紫。
lines.en: I climbed out of the void wearing purple.

lines.zh: 黑曜石柱立起来时，我在中间。
lines.en: When the obsidian pillars rose, I was at their center.

lines.zh: 这座岛醒来的时候，我也醒了。
lines.en: When this island woke, so did I.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀声的时候，已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you hear my wings, it's too late.

lines.zh: 末地总得有条龙，所以就是我。
lines.en: The End has to have a dragon, so it's me.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，像在夸我。
lines.en: Fire on me burns like a compliment.

lines.zh: 我飞了这么久，摔不着。
lines.en: I've flown this long; I don't fall.

lines.zh: 末地没有水，你在想什么？
lines.en: There's no water in the End. What were you thinking?

lines.zh: 床炸得不错，可惜只够痒。
lines.en: Nice bed explosion. Shame it only tickles.

lines.zh: 箭撞在鳞上，弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow struck my scales and bounced off.

lines.zh: 末地的魔法，归我管。
lines.en: Magic in the End answers to me.

lines.zh: 龙不吃东西，只吃时间。
lines.en: Dragons don't eat food; they eat time.

lines.zh: 雷？这里连云都没有。
lines.en: Lightning? There aren't even clouds here.

lines.zh: 虚空是我的邻居，我不怕。
lines.en: The void is my neighbor. I'm not afraid.
